d:
Bihar men agle mahine vidhanasbha chunav ke lie matdan hona hai. gopalganj ki bhore sit se transjendar mahila priti kinnar ummidvar hain. unhen prashant kishor ki jan suraj parti (jeespi) se tikat mila hai. priti kinnar ne bibisi hindi ko bataya ki vo kin muddon par chunav larengi aur unka ejenda kya rahega.
Riport: situ tivari
